scenes.say: You built the app. Now, how do you actually launch it without chaos? Let's break down the go-live and cutover process.

scenes.label: CAB
scenes.sub: Get an approved change ticket before go-live.
scenes.say: First, secure approval from the Change Advisory Board. No ticket, no launch.
Follow a timed runbook. Lower the DNS time-to-live so changes take effect quickly. Freeze config, run tests, and have a clear go or no-go call.
Set your rollback trigger before the window opens. Waiting until late at night under pressure leads to mistakes.

scenes.question: What happens after go-live?
scenes.wrong: You hand over and walk away.
scenes.right: You enter hypercare—monitoring, fast fixes, and support until business as usual.
scenes.say: After launch, you don't just hand off. You enter hypercare, watching closely and fixing issues fast until things stabilize.
